content.title: Explainable, site-specific anomaly detection for ProtoSense

facts.text: ArmaturaSec reports several terabytes of captures collected from consenting clients over three years, but no confirmed malicious examples. It also notes that historical compromises could have gone unnoticed; these archives are therefore unlabelled, not verified clean.

sources.quote: we have collected several terabytes of captures from consenting clients over the past three years
we have zero examples of malicious traffic
if they were compromised they would not know.

facts.text: The company reports that false positives from its earlier supervised classifier led clients to disable alerts. Its problem description connects alerting with site-specific behaviour and plain-language communication to plant managers.

sources.quote: it flagged so many false positives in real deployments that clients started switching the alerts off.
learns what normal looks like on a specific site
we can explain to a plant manager in plain language.

facts.text: Company material identifies ProtoSense as passive Modbus TCP and BACnet/IP inspection software and lists a custom Yocto Embedded Linux environment.

sources.quote: ProtoSense: passive protocol inspection module for Modbus TCP and BACnet/IP traffic
Embedded Linux (custom Yocto build)

facts.text: ArmaturaSec lists one to two part-time engineers, traffic archives, a hardware bench and firmware among its collaboration resources. Kiss’s material describes an ICS testbed accessible to industrial partners.

sources.quote: We can dedicate one to two engineers part-time to a collaborative project
with access to our traffic archives, our hardware bench, and our existing firmware codebase under NDA.
Her group's testbed capacity is available to industrial partners under a data-sharing agreement.

facts.text: Kiss’s Modbus research estimated per-register timing, payload-value and function-code distributions using kernel density estimation. Her incremental-model work also observed planned reconfiguration as a persistent anomaly and tested an operator-acknowledged reset.

sources.quote: For each register address, empirical distributions of inter-request intervals, payload values, and function code sequences were estimated using kernel density estimation
a supervised reset mechanism based on operator acknowledgement was proposed and tested.
Concept drift induced by a planned process reconfiguration was detected as a persistent anomaly episode

facts.text: Kiss’s gateway optimisation study used Modbus/TCP and DNP3 captures, not BACnet. Her Isolation Forest study reported a precision decline from 0.91 to 0.63 when the contamination estimate differed by an order of magnitude, illustrating calibration risk.

sources.quote: Experiments used three autoencoder architectures differing in depth (2, 4, 6 hidden layers) trained on Modbus/TCP and DNP3 captures.
a mismatch of one order of magnitude reduced average precision from 0.91 to 0.63.

facts.text: Kiss lists openness to joint projects with companies deploying ICS monitoring solutions.

sources.quote: joint projects with companies deploying ICS monitoring solutions

inferences: Site-specific statistical baselines suggest a practical starting point without attack-labelled training or operational calibration. Timing and command deviations could support understandable explanations, but contamination and automatic adaptation could conceal malicious behaviour.

The supplied evidence does not establish BACnet performance, plant-manager usability or fit on ArmaturaSec’s appliance. These are separate transfer gaps; published model reductions and results on other processors cannot establish hardware fit.
This joint-project proposal is conditional because Kiss’s availability is unknown. Her stated openness supports discussing the format, but does not constitute agreement to this project.
proposedActions: Propose a six-week feasibility experiment using site-specific chronological training, tuning and untouched evaluation captures; verify separation and independence, including replay duplicates. Train and calibrate without attack labels. Compare fixed-threshold rules with statistical/one-class candidates, selecting the best configuration on tuning data. Evaluate separately on held-out Modbus and BACnet traffic and isolated-bench injections plus legitimate process changes. Proposed go/no-go targets: at least 90% of independently defined injected episodes detected within 60 seconds; at most one false-or-unresolved alert episode per observed site-day; and at least 80% correct plant-manager interpretations of blinded explanations. Merge same-device alerts separated by at most 60 seconds; review every episode and divide counts by captured operating hours/24. Require confidence bounds supporting each target; insufficient evidence is inconclusive. Also require measured CPU, RAM and storage within agreed limits and no forwarding-latency increase beyond agreed measurement tolerance at representative peak load. Unavailable BACnet evaluation data blocks a BACnet pass; pooled results cannot substitute.

Propose expert review of an equal-probability random sample of all evaluation windows, including windows without alerts; predefine window length and sampling probability. Use these labels to investigate missed anomalies, not to infer episode counts: the alert-burden numerator uses a complete episode census. Measure detection only on injected or independently confirmed cases. Treat unresolved alerts conservatively, report exposure and uncertainty, and test operator-approved baseline resets against legitimate changes without automatically absorbing suspicious traffic.

Subject to agreement, ArmaturaSec could handle replay, bench integration and operator coordination within its part-time allocation; Kiss could lead features, calibration and evaluation. Use week one for permissions, budgets and protocol coverage, weeks two–four for tuning and bench work, and weeks five–six for frozen evaluation. Arrange the company NDA and researcher testbed data-sharing agreement before access. Record resource measurements directly on the selected appliance rather than extrapolating published results.
questions: Can Kiss confirm availability and interest in this specific joint project, with both parties agreeing staffing, funding and the proposed six-week scope?
Which captures and firmware may be used under customer permissions, the NDA and data-sharing agreement, including retention, anonymisation and reporting restrictions?
Which appliance and representative traffic loads should define resource and forwarding-latency limits, and can sufficient independent BACnet captures and safe bench scenarios be obtained?

Who can provide episode review, plant-manager explanation testing and baseline-reset authority, and what alert burden, detection delay and uncertainty criteria should replace or confirm the proposed targets?

benefits.company: The experiment could establish whether any tested configuration offers tolerable alert burden, understandable explanations and feasible appliance operation, with separate evidence for Modbus and BACnet.
benefits.researcher: Subject to agreement and permissions, Kiss could test how contamination, operational drift and protocol transfer affect calibrated one-class detection using company captures, controlled scenarios and appliance measurements.

# Explainable, site-specific anomaly detection for ProtoSense

## Verified facts
- ArmaturaSec reports several terabytes of captures collected from consenting clients over three years, but no confirmed malicious examples. It also notes that historical compromises could have gone unnoticed; these archives are therefore unlabelled, not verified clean. [F1]
- The company reports that false positives from its earlier supervised classifier led clients to disable alerts. Its problem description connects alerting with site-specific behaviour and plain-language communication to plant managers. [F2]
- Company material identifies ProtoSense as passive Modbus TCP and BACnet/IP inspection software and lists a custom Yocto Embedded Linux environment. [F3]
- ArmaturaSec lists one to two part-time engineers, traffic archives, a hardware bench and firmware among its collaboration resources. Kiss’s material describes an ICS testbed accessible to industrial partners. [F4]
- Kiss’s Modbus research estimated per-register timing, payload-value and function-code distributions using kernel density estimation. Her incremental-model work also observed planned reconfiguration as a persistent anomaly and tested an operator-acknowledged reset. [F5]
- Kiss’s gateway optimisation study used Modbus/TCP and DNP3 captures, not BACnet. Her Isolation Forest study reported a precision decline from 0.91 to 0.63 when the contamination estimate differed by an order of magnitude, illustrating calibration risk. [F6]
- Kiss lists openness to joint projects with companies deploying ICS monitoring solutions. [F7]

## Potential benefits
- For the company: The experiment could establish whether any tested configuration offers tolerable alert burden, understandable explanations and feasible appliance operation, with separate evidence for Modbus and BACnet.
- For the researcher: Subject to agreement and permissions, Kiss could test how contamination, operational drift and protocol transfer affect calibrated one-class detection using company captures, controlled scenarios and appliance measurements.

## Our inference
- Site-specific statistical baselines suggest a practical starting point without attack-labelled training or operational calibration. Timing and command deviations could support understandable explanations, but contamination and automatic adaptation could conceal malicious behaviour.
- The supplied evidence does not establish BACnet performance, plant-manager usability or fit on ArmaturaSec’s appliance. These are separate transfer gaps; published model reductions and results on other processors cannot establish hardware fit.
- This joint-project proposal is conditional because Kiss’s availability is unknown. Her stated openness supports discussing the format, but does not constitute agreement to this project.

## Proposed next steps
- Propose a six-week feasibility experiment using site-specific chronological training, tuning and untouched evaluation captures; verify separation and independence, including replay duplicates. Train and calibrate without attack labels. Compare fixed-threshold rules with statistical/one-class candidates, selecting the best configuration on tuning data. Evaluate separately on held-out Modbus and BACnet traffic and isolated-bench injections plus legitimate process changes. Proposed go/no-go targets: at least 90% of independently defined injected episodes detected within 60 seconds; at most one false-or-unresolved alert episode per observed site-day; and at least 80% correct plant-manager interpretations of blinded explanations. Merge same-device alerts separated by at most 60 seconds; review every episode and divide counts by captured operating hours/24. Require confidence bounds supporting each target; insufficient evidence is inconclusive. Also require measured CPU, RAM and storage within agreed limits and no forwarding-latency increase beyond agreed measurement tolerance at representative peak load. Unavailable BACnet evaluation data blocks a BACnet pass; pooled results cannot substitute.
- Propose expert review of an equal-probability random sample of all evaluation windows, including windows without alerts; predefine window length and sampling probability. Use these labels to investigate missed anomalies, not to infer episode counts: the alert-burden numerator uses a complete episode census. Measure detection only on injected or independently confirmed cases. Treat unresolved alerts conservatively, report exposure and uncertainty, and test operator-approved baseline resets against legitimate changes without automatically absorbing suspicious traffic.
- Subject to agreement, ArmaturaSec could handle replay, bench integration and operator coordination within its part-time allocation; Kiss could lead features, calibration and evaluation. Use week one for permissions, budgets and protocol coverage, weeks two–four for tuning and bench work, and weeks five–six for frozen evaluation. Arrange the company NDA and researcher testbed data-sharing agreement before access. Record resource measurements directly on the selected appliance rather than extrapolating published results.

## Open questions
- Can Kiss confirm availability and interest in this specific joint project, with both parties agreeing staffing, funding and the proposed six-week scope?
- Which captures and firmware may be used under customer permissions, the NDA and data-sharing agreement, including retention, anonymisation and reporting restrictions?
- Which appliance and representative traffic loads should define resource and forwarding-latency limits, and can sufficient independent BACnet captures and safe bench scenarios be obtained?
- Who can provide episode review, plant-manager explanation testing and baseline-reset authority, and what alert burden, detection delay and uncertainty criteria should replace or confirm the proposed targets?

content.title: Reducing Serbian Support-Search Misses Without Full Re-indexing

facts.text: LinguaBot reports that, among 12,000 real support queries from one bank client, about 18% returned no useful result; its analysis attributed more than half of those misses to morphology or script confusion.

sources.quote: in a sample of 12,000 real support queries from one bank client, about 18% returned no useful result
our analysis traced more than half of those misses directly to morphological mismatch or script confusion.

facts.text: The company uses Elasticsearch with a Croatian-oriented stemmer and reports Serbian-specific inflection failures and script switching, including within-word typos.

sources.quote: Our current Elasticsearch setup uses a basic stemmer that was built for Croatian and misses a significant share of Serbian-specific forms.
our users freely switch between Latin and Cyrillic script mid-sentence — sometimes mid-word in typos.

facts.text: LinguaBot reports that manual synonym maintenance does not scale with quarterly terminology additions. Its material also discusses updates as new vocabulary arrives.

sources.quote: maintaining those lists manually does not scale as clients add new product terminology every quarter.
can be updated when new vocabulary arrives without a full re-index.

facts.text: The company reports around 85,000 labelled query-response pairs across clients, two linguists able to annotate or validate solutions, and approximately EUR 8,000 for tooling or data work.

sources.quote: We have a labelled query-response dataset of around 85,000 pairs across all clients, and our two in-house linguists can annotate or validate proposed solutions.
Budget for tooling or data work is modest — around 8,000 EUR — and we want something testable within six months.

facts.text: Dragić’s work studies interactions between morphological reduction and script normalization. His phoneme-canonicalization research evaluated retrieval on legal documents, rather than customer-support traffic.

sources.quote: U ovom radu ispitujemo kako stemovanje i lematizacija interaguju s postupkom normalizacije skripte pri izgradnji pretražnog indeksa.
We evaluated the approach on a manually annotated gold standard of 4 200 query–document relevance pairs drawn from a legal corpus of 38 000 court decisions.

facts.text: Dragić lists openness to joint projects with companies managing Serbian-language collections. His notes describe two active projects, capacity for one smaller industrial engagement, and no interest in general software development without research.

sources.quote: joint projects with companies that manage large Serbian-language document collections
Trenutno je angažovan na dva aktivna projekta, ali ima kapaciteta za jedan manji industrijski ugovor ili konsultantski angažman.
nije zainteresovan za opšte projekte razvoja softvera bez istraživačke komponente.

facts.text: His company-pilot research identifies terminology updates as a limitation. His transliteration research reports deterministic-rule failures on loanwords, abbreviations and alphanumeric strings.

sources.quote: module treba ažurirati kada kompanija uvede novu terminologiju u jednom pismu, jer inicijalni rečnik sinonima nije potpun.
Deterministic rule-based transliteration between Serbian Cyrillic and Latin scripts handles the majority of tokens correctly, but fails on foreign loanwords, abbreviations, and alphanumeric strings.

inferences: This joint-project proposal is conditional: Dragić is open to the format, but his start date and weekly availability remain unknown, and his stated capacity is limited to a small engagement.

His methods suggest a focused research question: how do Serbian morphology and script canonicalization interact on short support queries? Transfer to banking and telecom terminology, especially within-word mixing, remains unvalidated.
Terminology-maintenance risks could persist after integration, and correcting morphology and script alone may leave enough other failures to miss the company’s target.
proposedActions: Propose a six-month experiment on separate tuning and held-out support-query samples. Against current Elasticsearch, test a controlled 2×2 matrix: existing versus Serbian morphology, crossed with existing versus phoneme-based script handling; keep documents and ranking fixed and tune operation ordering separately. Select the best configuration on tuning data, whichever it is. Test held-out short queries, within-word mixing, product-name exceptions and a subsequent vocabulary update. Proposed go/no-go: the selected configuration achieves below 5% no-useful-result queries, both overall and separately on held-out queries from the original bank population, and retains this result after vocabulary updates without full re-indexing. Require a testable prototype within six months, tooling/data spending within approximately EUR 8,000, and compliance with pre-agreed latency, precision-loss and maintenance-effort ceilings. Missing data, unresolved feasibility or insufficient statistical evidence means no pass. Log update operations to verify that neither full rebuilding nor continual manual synonym expansion is necessary.

Propose that LinguaBot supplies approved query, document and label extracts, and its linguists adjudicate every evaluation query at an agreed retrieval depth. Define miss rate as query occurrences with no useful result divided by all evaluated occurrences, without deduplication; count unresolved judgments as misses. Check tuning/evaluation independence across repeated queries and responses. Require the upper 95% confidence bound below 5% for each acceptance population; unavailable bank evaluation data remains a prerequisite.

Propose that Dragić designs the ablations and error analysis while LinguaBot engineers handle Elasticsearch integration, subject to agreed capacity. During month one, settle access, metric definitions and operating ceilings; use months two through four for tuning and months five through six for locked evaluation and update replay. Measure latency, precision, engineer/linguist maintenance hours and tooling/data spending. Test vocabulary additions separately from normalization-rule changes, since incremental document indexing does not establish rebuild-free rule updates.
questions: What start date, weekly commitment and research deliverables can Dragić confirm for this small joint project?
What client approvals, privacy controls and data-location restrictions govern access to queries, knowledge-base documents and relevance labels?
What retrieval depth defines a useful result, and what latency, precision-loss, maintenance-effort and deployment-resource ceilings should govern acceptance?

Does the no-full-re-index requirement permit an initial migration or auxiliary index, and how will researcher fees, integration ownership and company staff time be covered beyond the tooling/data envelope?

benefits.company: The experiment could identify which changes reduce actual support-search misses and whether those gains survive terminology updates within practical operating limits.
benefits.researcher: Subject to agreement and approved access, Dragić could test morphology–script interactions on short support queries and obtain an adjudicated transfer-error analysis beyond legal-document retrieval.

- What start date, weekly commitment and research deliverables can Dragić confirm for this small joint project?
- What client approvals, privacy controls and data-location restrictions govern access to queries, knowledge-base documents and relevance labels?
- What retrieval depth defines a useful result, and what latency, precision-loss, maintenance-effort and deployment-resource ceilings should govern acceptance?

content.title: Investigating chilled-service cracking in AutomVoj conveyor welds

facts.text: AutomVoj describes painted mild-steel hollow-section frames, with cracking at crossmember-to-stringer welds after about 18 months of continuous use. It reports replacing 14 complete assemblies under warranty this year.

sources.quote: Our conveyor frames are welded from mild steel hollow section and painted for corrosion resistance before delivery.
we are seeing weld joint cracking at the main crossmember-to-stringer connections after about 18 months of continuous use.
This year alone we have replaced 14 complete frame assemblies under warranty

facts.text: The company reports cold-store operation at 2–6 °C, while its loaded room-temperature workshop tests pass. It suspects thermal cycling, condensation and loaded-belt vibration acting together; this is not an established cause.

sources.quote: typically operating between 2 °C and 6 °C
We test frames under load at room temperature and they pass without any problem.
Our suspicion is that the combination of thermal cycling, condensation, and the vibration load from loaded belts

facts.text: AutomVoj has site photographs, crack measurements and two retained failed sections, rather than a documented representative sample of all warranty failures.

sources.quote: We have photos and measurements of the cracked joints from site visits, and we still have two of the failed sections in storage.

facts.text: AutomVoj lacks equipment and know-how for low-temperature cyclic-load testing. Erić's climate chamber and servo-hydraulic machine are shared with two other research groups.

sources.quote: We do not currently have the equipment or know-how to test at low temperatures under cyclic load.
Erić's climate chamber and servo-hydraulic machine are shared with two other research groups

facts.text: The company has no dedicated R&D department; its chief engineer and two senior automation engineers divide their time between live projects and improvement work.

sources.quote: We have no dedicated R&D department
our chief engineer and two senior automation engineers who allocate time between live projects and improvement work.

facts.text: Erić's thermal–mechanical fatigue study tested butt-welded S275JR plates between −30 °C and +20 °C. Out-of-phase loading produced shorter crack-initiation life than the room-temperature baseline.

sources.quote: superimposed thermal cycling (between −30 °C and +20 °C at 0.5 cycles per hour) during mechanical fatigue loading
butt-welded S275JR plates
Crack initiation life, defined as a 5% stiffness drop, was shortest in the out-of-phase TMF condition, averaging 28% fewer cycles than the room-temperature baseline.

facts.text: Erić lists openness to joint projects involving fatigue testing under low-temperature or combined loading conditions.

sources.quote: joint projects involving fatigue testing under low-temperature or combined loading conditions

inferences: This suggests a joint project could connect service measurements, fracture examination and controlled fatigue comparisons, rather than assume that cold temperature alone causes cracking.

Transfer remains unvalidated: the cited plate study differs in material, geometry, coating and temperature. Its shorter-life result highlights a damage risk, not a prediction for AutomVoj; accelerated testing could also reproduce the wrong mechanism.

The proposal is conditional because Erić's availability is unknown, despite his stated openness to this format. Shared equipment and limited company engineering capacity likely make a staged campaign more practical.
proposedActions: Propose testing representative painted hollow-section crossmember joints, informed by examination of the retained failures. Use a full eight-cell matrix: baseline, T, M, V, TM, TV, MV and TMV. Define T as steady chilled temperature versus measured thermal cycling; M as dry versus controlled condensation; V as absent versus measured belt vibration. Independently control these factors, retaining identical base mechanical loading, fabrication and coating, and add a matched room-temperature loaded comparator. Measure cycles to a predefined detectable crack, growth rate, origin and fracture morphology. Proposed go/no-go: replicated cracking must match the observed connection, origin and morphology under representative 2–6 °C service exposure; isolated-factor null results do not close the investigation. Select any modification using tuning specimens, then test the best configuration on separate held-out chilled-service specimens. A proposed improvement gate is at least 25% longer crack-initiation life than the current joint, with uncertainty excluding no improvement. Insufficient evidence means no pass; neither reproduction nor accelerated improvement establishes elimination of 18-month warranty failures.

Subject to agreement, AutomVoj would supply fabrication records, representative joints and site-measurement support; Erić would lead examination, experimental design and fatigue analysis. Reserve company engineering time and shared laboratory slots, and agree destructive allocation of the two sections before cutting. Propose a four-week feasibility stage followed by an eight-week pilot, conditional on bookings and measurable crack development rather than an agreed completion promise.

Verify fixture, humidity-control and corrosion-analysis capability before testing, seeking additional expertise if needed. Record actual loads, thermal transients and moisture exposure before setting factor levels. Allocate separate tuning and evaluation specimens and check their independence across fabrication batches. Compare welding, filler or geometry changes only after mechanism evidence emerges; retain all pairwise interactions in the matrix and use follow-up tests where results remain ambiguous.
questions: Can Erić confirm availability for this joint project and feasible shared-equipment booking windows?
What material, welding, coating and joint records, comparable unfailed joints, and permissions for destructive examination can AutomVoj provide?
Can customer-site access and laboratory capability support representative load, temperature and condensation measurements and controlled reproduction?
What budget, company staffing, completion deadline and acceptance criteria can both parties agree before starting?

benefits.company: The experiment could distinguish individual and interacting contributors to cracking and show whether a practical joint modification merits longer service validation.
benefits.researcher: Subject to agreement, Erić could test whether thermal–mechanical fatigue methods transfer to painted conveyor joints in mildly chilled, moisture-exposed service, using failure evidence and representative specimens.
